titleText: JTF News: BBC News, Deutsche Welle
mainText: Several people were wounded in a sword attack at a school in Sweden.
The United Nations reports an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is growing exponentially.
Two organizers of Hong Kong's Tiananmen vigils have been charged with inciting subversion.
The United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, and Canada issued statements criticizing Israel's West Bank settlement project.
A charter flight crash in Alaska resulted in 8 deaths.
